runners.name: Mighty Toro
runners.comment: MIGHTY TORO was closest in pursuit from the two path early, applied pressure at the halfway point, dueled around the far turn, grabbed the lead in upper stretch, kicked clear midstretch and drew away.

runners.name: Finiball
runners.comment: FINIBALL raced mid-pack outside a rival, driven two wide into the lane, angled out in upper stretch and rallied for second.

runners.name: Corkscrew Andy
runners.comment: CORKSCREW ANDY stalked the pace from inside, roused on the far turn, finished willingly down the lane but got edged for second.

runners.name: Pyrokinetic
runners.comment: PYROKINETIC raced on the inside towards the rear, shifted to the two path near the quarter pole, tipped out into the lane, got bumped shortly after and offered a mild response to round out the superfecta.

runners.name: Fuzzy Stare
runners.comment: FUZZY STARE showed the way from inside, took pressure at the half-mile pole, dueled around the far turn, surrendered the lead in upper stretch and flattened in the furlong grounds.

runners.name: Sigma Boy
runners.comment: SIGMA BOY pulled along the inside and steadied behind a rival early, settled in mid-pack, saved ground through the far turn, angled out and bumped PYROKINETIC at the top of the lane and lacked a rally.

runners.name: Black Pearl
runners.comment: BLACK PEARL unhurried in the beginning, trailed on the inside, passed a rival on the far turn, tipped out into the stretch, angled back inside and failed to menace.

runners.name: Charisma
runners.comment: CHARISMA settled three deep, dropped back to last while traveling three then two wide on the far turn and could not make an impact.

runners.name: Shapoval
runners.comment: SHAPOVAL stalked in the two path, came under a ride on the far turn and faded.

runners.name: Another Warrior
runners.comment: ANOTHER WARRIOR chased briefly then split rivals to challenge for command, dueled into and around the turn, kicked clear in upper stretch and widened in the final furlong under a drive.

runners.name: Awsome Amy
runners.comment: AWSOME AMY sped clear and crossed over, challenged by ANOTHER WARRIOR in the early going, held a short lead dueling from inside to the lane, yielded in upper stretch and kept on to secure second.

runners.name: Inca
runners.comment: INCA got bumped at the start, paused early when AWSOME AMY crossed in front, went up to press the pace three deep, chased after the top pair three then two wide on the turn, weakened in the lane but safely held third.

runners.name: Lovely Maya
runners.comment: LOVELY MAYA chased from inside, fell out of range on the turn and weakened.

runners.name: Olympian Thirst
runners.comment: OLYMPIAN THIRST broke out and bumped CANDY FOR JEANNE, sat off the pace staying well off the rail, went four wide into the turn, angled out and came six wide into the stretch and failed to menace.

runners.name: Oscar Storm
runners.comment: OSCAR STORM chased outside a rival or off the rail, dropped back four then five wide on the turn and tired.

runners.name: Candy for Jeanne
runners.comment: CANDY FOR JEANNE got sandwiched at the start, trailed from well off the rail, cut to the inside on the turn and never made an impact.

runners.name: Travelin' Show
runners.comment: TRAVELIN' SHOW taken back early, saved ground through the turn, moved out a bit at the top of the lane, cut back inside past the eighth pole, flew late from the fence and nailed GEEZER in the shadow of the wire.

runners.name: Geezer
runners.comment: GEEZER tracked between rivals, crept closer in the two path on the turn, bid three deep in upper stretch, put a head in front in deep stretch but got nailed by the winner.

runners.name: Its a Cinch
runners.comment: ITS A CINCH vied for the lead inside a pair of rivals, dueled around the turn, resisted into the final sixteenth and yielded grudgingly late.

runners.name: Grey's Boy
runners.comment: GREY'S BOY broke well then gave chase from inside, drew closer around the bend, moved out a bit into the stretch, finished gamely between in the late stages and just missed third.

runners.name: Double Jab
runners.comment: DOUBLE JAB tracked three deep between rivals early, chased three then two wide on the turn, angled out midstretch and finished well.

runners.name: Jack Fish
runners.comment: JACK FISH vied between rivals up the backstretch, dueled from outside on the turn, battled into deep stretch and could not summon the needed final kick.

runners.name: Whopper Factor
runners.comment: WHOPPER FACTOR tracked four deep up the backstretch, continued in the four path to the stretch, moved out in the lane and kept trying but needed to find more.

runners.name: Sirnami
runners.comment: SIRNAMI settled inside, hugged the rail to the stretch, moved out in upper stretch, tried to split rivals but lacked room and checked late and could not regain momentum.

runners.name: Italio
runners.comment: ITALIO vied three deep early, chased after the top pair in the three path on the turn and weakened down the lane.

runners.name: Tygra
runners.comment: TYGRA broke a bit slow, traveled near the back, went four deep into the turn, moved to the three path then angled back out around the bend, came five wide into the stretch and failed to rally.

runners.name: Another Bulleit
runners.comment: ANOTHER BULLEIT chased widest up the backstretch, went four to five wide around the bend, took a bad step at the sixteenth pole and was eased late, then was transported off the track via equine ambulance.

runners.name: Tiz Lady Luck
runners.comment: TIZ LADY LUCK stalked four deep up the backstretch, challenged for the lead four deep around the bend, fought three deep into the lane, battled with RAHAB in the final furlong and dug in to edge that rival for the upset.

runners.name: Rahab
runners.comment: RAHAB stalked the lone leader from between rivals, bid between in the two path on the turn, put a head in front outside the quarter pole, fought along the inside with outer pair turning for home, fought head to head with TIZ LADY LUCK in the furlong grounds and got outgamed by the winner.

runners.name: Dear Diary
runners.comment: DEAR DIARY chased out of range of the leader from off the rail, went two wide into the turn, eased out to the four path around the bend, put in a mild rally and earned the show honors.

runners.name: Dragon Reign
runners.comment: DRAGON REIGN threw his head at the start and came away slow, had one beat two wide into the turn, angled out and came five wide into the stretch and improved position down the lane.

runners.name: Sharon's Joy
runners.comment: SHARON'S JOY stalked the leader three deep between rivals, bid three deep between on the turn, vied in the two path leaving the bend, yielded to the top pair with a furlong remaining and flattened in the late stages.

runners.name: Bunners
runners.comment: BUNNERS lugged in toward the temporary rail early, straightened course and pursued the leader from inside, chased two wide into the lane, tipped out and weakened.

runners.name: Thirteen Kisses
runners.comment: THIRTEEN KISSES sped clear and set the tone early, vied with outer trio on the turn, lost command at the quarter pole, chased into the stretch and tired.

runners.name: Real as It Gets
runners.comment: REAL AS IT GETS trailed the field up the backstretch, saved ground around the bend and was never a factor.

runners.name: Paddock Buzz
runners.comment: PADDOCK BUZZ vied for the lead from inside then ceded command to outer pair, stalked along the rail into the turn, eased off the fence and took aim from the three path turning for home, challenged from outside in upper stretch, seized command midstretch and drove clear.

runners.name: Storming Again
runners.comment: STORMING AGAIN pressed the pace three deep then dueled leaving the backstretch, fought outside TERRY'S GIRL through the turn, took control in upper stretch, led between rivals at the eighth pole, lost the lead midstretch and stayed on for a clear second.

runners.name: Terry's Girl
runners.comment: TERRY'S GIRL vied between rivals then carried a short lead over STORMING AGAIN into the turn, dueled along the rail around the bend, lost command in upper stretch, yielded to the top pair past the eighth pole and managed to hold on for third.

runners.name: Grazed in a Haze
runners.comment: GRAZED IN A HAZE pursued in range then dropped out of striking distance when racing greenly up the backstretch, eased off the rail to the three path around the bend, moved out in the lane, showed a mild rally and almost got by TERRY'S GIRL for third.

runners.name: Milady Erin
runners.comment: MILADY ERIN chased three deep then outside a rival in the early going, took the turn two to three wide and could not rally.

runners.name: Raging Aura
runners.comment: RAGING AURA hustled early, stalked the top trio, chased after the dueling pair around the bend, went two wide into the lane, drifted out in upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Princess Star
runners.comment: PRINCESS STAR came away slow then got crowded and checked early, saved ground from well off the pace and lacked a rally.

runners.name: Baby Blue Girl
runners.comment: BABY BLUE GIRL raced in mid-pack and angled inside, hugged the rail to the stretch and failed to rally.

runners.name: Negotiating Terms
runners.comment: NEGOTIATING TERMS broke inward, dropped off the pace, went two to three wide on the turn and was never a factor.

runners.name: Hatti McDaniel
runners.comment: HATTI MCDANIEL came away slow, raced near the back, saved ground to the lane and never made an impact.

runners.name: Cuore Mio
runners.comment: CUORE MIO was off slow to begin then lost a clear path early, traveled two, three, then four wide on the turn and lacked a response when called upon.

runners.name: Baby Houseman
runners.comment: BABY HOUSEMAN came away very slow, trailed to the stretch and never got involved.

runners.name: Midnite Musket
runners.comment: MIDNITE MUSKET prompted the pace from outside, took over past the three-eighths pole, cleared midway around the bend and was kept busy through the lane to maintain a comfortable lead to the wire.

runners.name: Zombo Bombo
runners.comment: ZOMBO BOMBO showed the way early under pressure from MIDNITE MUSKET, lost command past the three-eighths pole, chased after that rival midway around the bend, cut the corner into the stretch and stayed on to outduel DOO WOP DON for second.

runners.name: Doo Wop Don
runners.comment: DOO WOP DON raced off the pace out wide, came six wide into the lane, showed late run and got up for the show honors.

runners.name: Tapalo
runners.comment: TAPALO chased outside a pair of rivals leaving the backstretch, remained three wide through the turn and flattened out in the lane.

runners.name: Mandela Effect
runners.comment: MANDELA EFFECT dropped back early, stayed away from the rail, spun five wide into the lane and improved position.

runners.name: Baladi
runners.comment: BALADI chased along the inside, driven two wide into the stretch and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: Cupid's Crusader
runners.comment: CUPID'S CRUSADER ridden along early from off the pace, went between rivals into the turn, found the rail around the bend, moved out in the lane and never threatened.

runners.name: Ya'll Come
runners.comment: YA'LL COME tracked four deep into the turn, came five wide into the lane, chased between at the eighth pole and weakened.

runners.name: Spiritist
runners.comment: SPIRITIST chased two wide between rivals into the turn, dropped back around the turn and had little left for the drive.

runners.name: Smarty Nose
runners.comment: SMARTY NOSE trailed along the inside, went two wide into the stretch, angled out and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: Perfecto Amor
runners.comment: PERFECTO AMOR raced up close in the opening stages, lost ground two, three, then four wide on the turn and faded in the lane.

runners.name: Barrister Proof
runners.comment: BARRISTER PROOF chased from out of range and moved inside, lost ground on the turn and also faded.

runners.name: Virat
runners.comment: VIRAT settled inside, moved into range leaving the backstretch, crept closer along the rail then in the two path on the turn, brushed with outer rival at the top of the lane, rallied from between rivals to grab the lead at the sixteenth pole and gamely prevailed.

runners.name: Matt At Five
runners.comment: MATT AT FIVE followed in range off the rail, took aim three wide through the turn, brushed with VIRAT at the top of the stretch, fought four deep into the final sixteenth and got outkicked by that rival.

runners.name: Incanto (IRE)
runners.comment: INCANTO (IRE) bumped early, traveled inside a rival at the back, bid between rivals in the lane, got crowded at the sixteenth pole and kept on gamely to the wire.

runners.name: Book Smart
runners.comment: BOOK SMART sprinted clear and crossed over, took pressure into the turn, headed at the five-sixteenths pole, put REGAL PATRIOT away at the eighth pole but got outkicked by the top trio in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Mescalero
runners.comment: MESCALERO bumped with outer rival early, sat off the pace between rivals, drew closer nearing the turn, chased two wide around the bend, paused behind rivals at the three-sixteenths pole, then kept trying once in the clear but needed to find more.

runners.name: Wound Up
runners.comment: WOUND UP settled outside rivals, moved closer leaving the backstretch, took the turn four wide and failed to rally.

runners.name: Arrakis
runners.comment: ARRAKIS lost a clear path leaving the gate, traveled outside a rival at the rear, took the turn two wide, cut in at the three-sixteenths pole and was never a factor.

runners.name: Regal Patriot
runners.comment: REGAL PATRIOT raced up close on the inside, moved off the fence and challenged the leader into the turn, fought on even terms at the five-sixteenths pole, dueled to upper stretch, lost touch with the leader past the eighth pole, got put in tight briefly and weakened.

runners.name: Queen of Bantry
runners.comment: QUEEN OF BANTRY sped clear and steered to the inside, came under a ride late on the bend, met the bid from MUSTANG KNICKEY at the three-sixteenths pole and turned that rival away in the last sixteenth.

runners.name: Mustang Knicky
runners.comment: MUSTANG KNICKY stalked the lone leader outside a rival, bid two wide entering the stretch, fought to midstretch and got turned away in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Endless Edgy
runners.comment: ENDLESS EDGY chased outside a pair of rivals, went three then two wide on the turn and finished evenly through the lane.

runners.name: Imnotvanillasky
runners.comment: IMNOTVANILLASKY sat off the pace in the early going, chased three deep at the five-sixteenths pole, churned on down the stretch and rounded out the superfecta.

runners.name: Hayley Amber
runners.comment: HAYLEY AMBER unhurried in the opening stages, stayed off the rail, had the rider lose the crop while traveling in the three path at the three-sixteenths pole, offered a mild response to hand urging and improved position.

runners.name: Native Empress
runners.comment: NATIVE EMPRESS trailed up the backstretch, passed a rival on the turn, spun five wide into the lane and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: Low La Bunny
runners.comment: LOW LA BUNNY chased between rivals then outside a rival, exchanged bumps with GENUINE GRACE early on the turn, continued two wide to the lane and had little left for the drive.

runners.name: Genuine Grace
runners.comment: GENUINE GRACE was reluctant loading, chased from inside out of range, exchanged bumps with LOW LA BUNNY early on the turn, lost ground around the bend and tired in the drive.

runners.name: Unusual Exchange
runners.comment: UNUSUAL EXCHANGE raced up close in the opening stages, started to weaken at the five-sixteenths pole and faded in the lane.

runners.name: Tropical Rain Day
runners.comment: TROPICAL RAIN DAY bobbled leaving the gate but recovered quickly, chased outside a pair of rivals then off the rail, raced four deep at the five-sixteenths pole and was not persevered with in the stretch run.

runners.name: Chuparrosa
runners.comment: CHUPARROSA raced off the pace on the inside, lost ground leaving the backstretch, dropped back to last on the turn, eased in the lane and walked off.

runners.name: Anya
runners.comment: ANYA reared when the gate opened then hopped and lost the rider, ran around the course before being apprehended by the outrider and walked off.

runners.name: Dairago (FR)
runners.comment: DAIRAGO (FR) unhurried in the opening stages, steered to the inside, roused at the quarter pole, angled out in upper stretch, rallied four deep between rivals into the final sixteenth and closest fastest for the score.

runners.name: Cathal (IRE)
runners.comment: CATHAL (IRE) stalked from inside, put into chase mode late on the far turn, tipped out a bit at the top of the stretch, bid between rivals at the sixteenth pole and got outclosed by the winner.

runners.name: Amplitude
runners.comment: AMPLITUDE settled in the two path then raced a bit off the rail, followed in range at the seven-sixteenths pole, took aim in the two path turning for home, bid three deep with a sixteenth remaining and got outkicked by the top pair.

runners.name: Zalamo (FR)
runners.comment: ZALAMO (FR) sat off the pace outside a rival, went three deep into the far turn, moved into striking distance around the bend, rallied five deep in the late stages and got outkicked.

runners.name: Dealers Special
runners.comment: DEALERS SPECIAL broke a step slow, trailed on the inside around the clubhouse turn, continued at the back with KIMMER to the outside, traveled between rivals past the five-sixteenths pole, waited from the quarter pole to the three-sixteenths marker, roused in upper stretch, rallied from inside but got going too late.

runners.name: Calm Sea
runners.comment: CALM SEA showed early foot along the rail then took a stalking position nearing the clubhouse turn, switched to the two path, applied pressure to the leader at the nine-sixteenths pole, took over approaching the five-sixteenths marker, cleared inner rival turning for home, challenged by rivals into the final sixteenth and weakened late.

runners.name: Kimmer
runners.comment: KIMMER traveled two wide near the back, trailed outside DEALERS SPECIAL in the middle stages, raced three deep at the quarter pole, chased four wide into the lane and offered a mild response down the lane.

runners.name: Phosphorescence (FR)
runners.comment: PHOSPHORESCENCE (FR) took a stalking position in the two path, raced between rivals into the far turn, got crowded past the five-sixteenths pole, continued two wide into the lane and failed to rally.

runners.name: Neon Lights (IRE)
runners.comment: NEON LIGHTS (IRE) dueled from outside then cleared CALM SEA to take control and moved inside, pressured by that rival at the nine-sixteenths pole, lost command past the five-sixteenths marker, yielded to CALM SEA nearing the stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Lahaina Flavor
runners.comment: LAHAINA FLAVOR moved to the inside racing towards the rear, followed between rivals leaving the backstretch, rounded the far turn two then three wide and could not summon the needed rally.
